decisions.rationale: Head nearly in profile and in line with the body (best for a quadruped rig); all four legs separated. b and c turn the head to camera.

Cooked 5,895 triangles, 595 KB, 1.3 m tall (0.95 m class at the shoulder, x1.28 heroic scale). Five clips (Idle, Graze, Walk 1.0 m/s, Run 4.2 m/s, Startle) reviewed in the animation page: hooves stay planted (foot lock 4.5 cm), no flapping legs after per-leg weighting.

Flocks of 5-9 graze, wander, startle and flee from the hero (9 m / 15 m) in every settlement pasture; animate within 60 m, hidden beyond 120 m. Limitation: procedural clips, no blending between grazing and walking; fleece is TRELLIS texture, no fur shading.
